parameters.command: python3 "{{ $('Set Variables').item.json.scriptsFolder }}/trigger_word_detection.py" "{{ $('Process VAD Results').item.json.silenceRemovedPath }}" "{{ $('Set Variables').item.json.outputFolder }}/trigger_results.json" {{ $('Set Variables').item.json.whisperModel }} 2>&1

ffmpeg -i "{{ $('Process Cut Points').item.json.mistakesRemovedPath }}" -af "loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11,highpass=f=80,lowpass=f=12000,acompressor=threshold=0.089:ratio=9:attack=200:release=1000" -c:v copy "{{ $('Process Cut Points').item.json.outputFolder }}/audio_enhanced.mp4" -y 2>&1 && echo "AUDIO_ENHANCED_OK"

ffmpeg -i "{{ $('Process Cut Points').item.json.outputFolder }}/audio_enhanced.mp4" -vf "eq=contrast=1.15:saturation=0.9:brightness=0.02,colortemperature=temperature=6500" -c:a copy "{{ $('Process Cut Points').item.json.outputFolder }}/color_graded.mp4" -y 2>&1 && echo "COLOR_GRADED_OK"

FONT=$(fc-match --format='%{file}' 'DejaVu Sans:bold' 2>/dev/null || echo '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf') && ffmpeg -i "{{ $('Process Cut Points').item.json.outputFolder }}/color_graded.mp4" -filter_complex "color=c=black:s=1920x1080:d=3:r=30[intro_v];aevalsrc=0:c=stereo:s=44100:d=3[intro_a];[intro_v]drawtext=fontfile=${FONT}:text='{{ $('Set Variables').item.json.introText }}':fontcolor=white:fontsize=72:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=(h-text_h)/2[intro_titled];[intro_titled][0:v]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0[outv];[intro_a][0:a]concat=n=2:v=0:a=1[outa]" -map "[outv]" -map "[outa]" -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 18 -c:a aac -b:a 192k "{{ $('Process Cut Points').item.json.outputFolder }}/with_intro.mp4" -y 2>&1 && echo "INTRO_ADDED_OK"

INPUT_BASENAME=$(basename "{{ $('Set Variables').item.json.inputVideoPath }}" .mp4) && ffmpeg -i "{{ $('Process Cut Points').item.json.outputFolder }}/with_intro.mp4" -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 18 -profile:v high -level 4.1 -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 44100 "{{ $('Process Cut Points').item.json.outputFolder }}/${INPUT_BASENAME}_edited.mp4" -y 2>&1 && echo "FINAL_EXPORT_OK"

string.name: message
string.value: Video editing complete. Check outputFolder for the _edited.mp4 file.
